reason: A HarmonyOS/OpenHarmony application development plugin covering ArkTS and ArkUI work, project builds, device debugging, UI inspection, and basic device interaction through a local MCP server.

summaries.zh: 面向 HarmonyOS 和 OpenHarmony 应用开发，提供 ArkTS/ArkUI 编写、项目构建、设备调试、界面检查及基础 UI 操作能力。
summaries.en: A HarmonyOS and OpenHarmony development plugin for ArkTS/ArkUI coding, project builds, device debugging, UI inspection, and basic UI interactions.

capabilities: Writes and refactors ArkTS and ArkUI code
Runs HarmonyOS project builds using hvigor or hvigorw
Installs, uninstalls, and launches HAP applications on connected devices or emulators
Captures screenshots and UI layout trees
Performs coordinate-based taps, swipes, text input, and key events
